newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian budget deficit 8.1 mln lats by Feb 13.
newsitem.headline: Latvian budget deficit 8.1 mln lats by Feb 13.

text.p: Latvia's state budget deficit this year amounted to 8.1 million lats by February 13, the finance ministry said on Friday.
Revenues so far this year amounted to 60.508 million lats and expenditure reached 68.653 million lats, the ministry said in a statment.
It also said that internal state debt totalled 433.56 million lats.
This was financed by the state Treasury bills worth 124.57 million lats and credits from commercial banks worth 34.10 million lats as well as 72.25 million lats of IMF credits.
